```{r setup,include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
directory <- paste0(getwd(), "/")
df_work        <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv.xlsx"), sheet = "work")
df_education   <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv.xlsx"), sheet = "education")
df_examples    <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv.xlsx"), sheet = "examples")
# cv_v2 is cv_v1 with a new layout, so it shows the skills of cv_v1:
# column cv empty (every CV) or "v1"
df_examples    <- df_examples[is.na(df_examples$cv) | df_examples$cv == "v1", ]
df_details     <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv.xlsx"), sheet = "details")
df_description <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv.xlsx"), sheet = "description")
df_projects    <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(paste0(directory, "cv.xlsx"), sheet = "projects")
# the full contact details (the address, email, ...) instead of the short labels
df_details$label <- ifelse(is.na(df_details$label_full), df_details$label, df_details$label_full)
# jobs at the same company one after the other become one entry (Evalion part
# time, then full time): from the first start to the last finish, each period in
# the status, and the longest description
merge_jobs <- function(df) {
  group <- cumsum(c(TRUE, df$company[-1] != df$company[-nrow(df)]))
  merged <- lapply(split(df, group), function(g) {
    if (nrow(g) == 1) return(g)
    g <- g[order(as.numeric(g$date_start)), ]
    period <- ifelse(g$date_finish == "present", paste("since", g$date_start),
                     paste0(g$date_start, "–", g$date_finish))
    out <- g[which.max(nchar(g$responsibilities)), ]
    out$date_start <- g$date_start[1]
    out$date_finish <- if (any(g$date_finish == "present")) "present" else as.character(max(as.numeric(g$date_finish)))
    out$status <- paste(g$status, period, collapse = ", ")
    out
  })
  do.call(rbind, merged)
}
df_work <- merge_jobs(df_work)

# One entry on the two-column grid every section shares: a grey left column
# (dates, project type, skill group) and the content on the right.
#   head:    first line; right: grey italic text at its right end
#   lines:   what follows; bullets = TRUE puts each in its own bullet
#   gap:     space after the entry
tex_entry <- function(left, head, right = NA, lines = character(), bullets = TRUE, gap = "5pt") {
  if (!is.na(right) && nzchar(right))
    head <- paste0(head, "\\hspace{0pt plus 1filll}\\hspace{6pt}{\\small\\color{muted}\\itshape ", right, "}")
  # the left cell starts its line before the colour: a colour switched on before
  # the first line drops the cell below the row's baseline
  out <- paste0("\\noindent\\begin{tabularx}{\\linewidth}{@{}>{\\small\\raggedright\\arraybackslash\\hyphenpenalty=10000\\leavevmode\\color{muted}}p{2.55cm}X@{}}\n",
                left, " & ", head, "\\tabularnewline\n")
  if (length(lines)) {
    body <- if (bullets)
      paste0("\\hangindent=1em\\hangafter=1\\makebox[1em][l]{\\textcolor{accent!55}{\\textbullet}}",
             lines, "\\par", collapse = "\n")
    else paste(lines, collapse = " ")
    out <- paste0(out, "& {\\small ", body, "}\\tabularnewline\n")
  }
  paste0(out, "\\end{tabularx}\\par\\vspace{", gap, "}\n")
}
dot <- "\\enspace{\\color{muted}\\textperiodcentered}\\enspace "
```

```{r details,results='asis',echo=FALSE}
contacts <- character()
for (i in 1:nrow(df_details)) {
  icon <- sub("\\\\+$", "", df_details$icon[i])
  link <- df_details$link[i]
  label <- df_details$label[i]
  if (grepl("^(https?://|mailto:|tel:)", link)) label <- paste0("\\href{", link, "}{", label, "}")
  contacts <- c(contacts, paste0("\\makebox[1.2em][l]{\\color{white!62!accent}", icon, "}", label))
}
# three per row, white text and links on the band
cat("{\\small\\hypersetup{urlcolor=white}\\begin{tabularx}{\\linewidth}{@{}XXX@{}}\n")
rows <- split(contacts, ceiling(seq_along(contacts) / 3))
for (r in rows) cat(paste0("  ", paste(c(r, rep("", 3 - length(r))), collapse = " & "), "\\\\[2pt]\n"))
cat("\\end{tabularx}}\n")
```

\cvsection{Experience}
```{r work_experience,results='asis',echo=FALSE}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_work))) {
  # the cell separates sentences with \\ : each one becomes a bullet
  resp <- trimws(strsplit(df_work$responsibilities[i], "\\\\", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
  cat(tex_entry(paste0(df_work$date_start[i], "--", df_work$date_finish[i]),
                paste0("\\textbf{", df_work$company[i], "}", dot, df_work$role[i]),
                right = df_work$status[i], lines = resp[nzchar(resp)], gap = "7pt"))
}
```

\cvsection{Projects}
```{r projects,results='asis',echo=FALSE}
# one table: type | name | description. The name column is as wide as the
# longest name, so every description starts at the same tab stop
cat("\\noindent\\begin{tabularx}{\\linewidth}{@{}>{\\small\\raggedright\\arraybackslash\\hyphenpenalty=10000\\leavevmode\\color{muted}}p{2.55cm}l@{\\hspace{16pt}}X@{}}\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_projects))) {
  # "Shiny app: World Bank indicators explorer" -> type on the left, the rest in the description
  d <- df_projects$description[i]
  type <- ""
  if (grepl(": ", d, fixed = TRUE)) {
    type <- sub(":.*$", "", d)
    d <- sub("^[^:]*:\\s*", "", d)
  }
  # a project with an empty link cell is plain bold text, not a link to "NA"
  link <- df_projects$link[i]
  name <- if (!is.na(link) && nzchar(link))
    paste0("\\href{", link, "}{\\textbf{\\textcolor{linkblue}{", df_projects$name[i], "}}}")
  else paste0("\\textbf{", df_projects$name[i], "}")
  cat(paste0(type, " & ", name, " & {\\small ", d, "}\\tabularnewline[2.5pt]\n"))
}
cat("\\end{tabularx}\\par\n")
```

\cvsection[links open worked examples]{Skills}
```{r skills,results='asis',echo=FALSE}
# items stay whole; a line may only break between two items, and the dot
# between them disappears at the break
# (the colour sits in its own group: its reset must stay inside the box)
sep <- "\\discretionary{}{}{\\hbox{\\kern0.55em{\\color{accent!40}\\textbullet}\\kern0.55em}}"
for (cat_name in unique(df_examples$Experience)) {
  rows <- df_examples[df_examples$Experience %in% cat_name, ]
  items <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(j) {
    name <- rows$full_name[j]
    if (tolower(name) != tolower(rows$abbreviation[j])) name <- paste0(name, " (", rows$abbreviation[j], ")")
    if (!is.na(rows$link[j]) && nzchar(rows$link[j])) name <- paste0("\\href{", rows$link[j], "}{\\textcolor{linkblue}{", name, "}}")
    paste0("\\mbox{", name, "}")
  }, "")
  cat(tex_entry(cat_name, paste0("{\\small ", paste(items, collapse = sep), "}"), gap = "3pt"))
}
```
